enchantment.practical_enchantments.destr: Destroys mined blocks and produces experience
enchantment.practical_enchantments.incin: Completely destroys mobs, dropping more experience
enchantment.practical_enchantments.aeria: Removes the mining speed penalty while airborne
enchantment.practical_enchantments.behea: Increases the chance for mobs to drop their heads
enchantment.practical_enchantments.life_: Restores a small amount of health based on the target's actual health lost after hitting
enchantment.practical_enchantments.frenz: Grants a Speed effect after killing an enemy
enchantment.practical_enchantments.demon: Pays emeralds to a demon to avoid death, but with a corresponding punishment...
enchantment.practical_enchantments.undyi: Trades dropping all inventory items for one chance to escape death
enchantment.practical_enchantments.gentl: Grants permanent Slow Falling, canceled by sneaking
enchantment.practical_enchantments.execu: Deals more damage to low-health targets
enchantment.practical_enchantments.disgu: Mobs corresponding to the head no longer attack you on their own
enchantment.practical_enchantments.cat_c: Like a little cat staying by your side~
enchantment.practical_enchantments.cat_a: The 'cats' have lowered their guard around you
practical_enchantments.notice.merlinlib: Practical Enchantments: the original dependency EnchantLib is no longer maintained, so since 1.3.0 MerlinLib is the only dependency this mod needs. Any problem with this mod can be reported to the author anywhere you can think of; ideas for new enchantments are always welcome. This notice can be switched off in the MerlinLib configuration screen.
